node.statement: The canonical maps from an n-by-1 or 1-by-n matrix corner into M_{n+1} obtained by adjoining zero rows and columns are isometries: the operator-space matrix norm axiom gives contractivity of insertion by scalar coordinate isometries and of extraction by their adjoints, yielding equality. Since A is a self-adjoint operator space, involution is isometric. Consequently ||C_X||=||X|| and ||R_Y||=||Y^dagger||=||Y||.
